name: Geometric Collage
description: The second clip arrives cut into a geometric poster of quarter discs, half discs, triangles and their complements: piece after piece swings in around a corner of its cell, a flat plate of color just ahead of it, and lands flat with a soft paper shadow. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: cells
params.description: Number of cells along the short side of the frame, the long side gets as many as keep them about square

params.name: stagger
params.description: How spread out in time the pieces arrive: 0 swings them all in together, 1 lands them one after another

params.name: plates
params.description: Show a flat plate of color swinging in just ahead of each piece

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadows the pieces cast while they swing in
